messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Kannada, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Kannada line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
ಓ, ಇತರ ಕವಿಗಳ ಗೌರವ ಮತ್ತು ಬೆಳಕು, ನನ್ನ ದೀರ್ಘ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮತ್ತು ಮಹಾ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯನ್ನು ನನಗೆ ಉಪಯೋಗಿಸು ಇವುಗಳು ನನ್ನನ್ನು ನಿನ್ನ ಗ್ರಂಥವನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಲು ಮಾಡಿವೆ.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (Eng.) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|--------------------------|--------| | O | vocative interjection addressing abstract entities | ಓ | “O” | OK | | de | preposition “of” linking honor & light to other poets | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | li | definite article plural “the” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | altri | adjective “other” modifying *poeti* | ಇತರ | “other” | OK | | poeti | noun “poets” (genitive) | ಕವಿಗಳ | “of poets” | OK | | onore | noun “honor” | ಗೌರವ | “honor” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | ಮತ್ತು | “and” | OK | | lume | noun “light” | ಬೆಳಕು | “light” | OK | | vagliami | imperative “make (it) useful to me” | ಉಪಯೋಗಿಸು | “use / make useful” | OK | | ’l (article before *lungo*) | definite article “the” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | lungo | adjective “long” | ದೀರ್ಘ | “long” | OK | | studio | noun “study” | ಅಧ್ಯಯನ | “study” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | ಮತ್ತು | “and” | OK | | ’l (article before *grande*) | definite article “the” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | grande | adjective “great” | ಮಹಾ | “great” | OK | | amore | noun “love” (accusative) | ಪ್ರೀತಿಯನ್ನು | “love” | OK | | che | relative pronoun “which” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | m' | clitic pronoun “me” (object) | ನನ್ನನ್ನು | “me” | OK | | ha | auxiliary verb “has” (perfect) | ಮಾಡಿವೆ | “has made” (part of verb) | OK | | fatto | past participle “made” | ಮಾಡಿವೆ | “made” | OK | | cercar | infinitive “to search” | ಹುಡುಕಲು | “to search” | OK | | lo | definite article “the” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | tuo | possessive adjective “your” | ನಿನ್ನ | “your” | OK | | volume | noun “volume” (accusative) | ಗ್ರಂಥವನ್ನು | “volume / book” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `de`, `li`, `’l` (twice), `che`, `lo` – Italian articles, prepositions, and relative pronoun are naturally omitted in Kannada; their meaning is conveyed by case marking or word order. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected in the mapping.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Kannada script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 82: - Original: ಓ, ಇತರ ಕವಿಗಳ ಗೌರವ ಮತ್ತು ಬೆಳಕು, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 83: - Original: ನನ್ನ ದೀರ್ಘ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮತ್ತು ಮಹಾ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯನ್ನು ನನಗೆ ಉಪಯೋಗಿಸು - Issue: missing accusative case marker after “ಅಧ್ಯಯನ” - Corrected: ನನ್ನ ದೀರ್ಘ ಅಧ್ಯಯನವನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಮಹಾ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯನ್ನು ನನಗೆ ಉಪಯೋಗಿಸು
- Line 84: - Original: ಇವುಗಳು ನನ್ನನ್ನು ನಿನ್ನ ಗ್ರಂಥವನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಲು ಮಾಡಿವೆ. - Issue: resultative construction can be expressed more naturally with “ಹುಡುಕುವಂತೆ” - Corrected: ಇವುಗಳು ನನ್ನನ್ನು ನಿನ್ನ ಗ್ರಂಥವನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿವೆ.
